headline: Modernization work depends on evidence, AI assistance, and accountable human decisions.
subhead: AI can organize evidence and draft artifacts; people provide context, make choices, and own change.
stage_1_ai: Structure interview notes and flag unanswered questions for follow-up.
stage_1_human: Subject matter experts confirm meaning, exceptions, and local terminology.
stage_2_ai: Map handoffs, decision points, exceptions, and rework from approved records.
stage_2_human: Teams explain why steps occur and which controls must remain.
stage_3_ai: Connect applications, data, interfaces, dependencies, risks, and lifecycle signals.
stage_3_human: Technology owners validate boundaries, feasibility, and trade-offs.
stage_4_ai: Draft process alternatives and prototypes for structured review.
stage_4_human: Users and leaders decide what fits operating needs and policy.
stage_5_ai: Organize role guidance, decision records, and technical context for handoff.
stage_5_human: Leaders own readiness, adoption, and operating accountability.
qualification: AI prepares evidence and drafts; accountable people validate facts, approve changes, and govern adoption.
